name: seed-equivalence-guard
body: The eligibility check that admits the splice only when the local seed provably matches the shared recorded scan: the seed's own recorded content-identity key must equal the shared record's (missing key on either side is ineligible). A refusal hands the caller to the full load (the correctness reference). This change-set extends the guard to also require the assembled graph's durable-layer/transient rows to be already represented in the seed, so a spec-only change-set cannot publish a diverged DB.
